scope: Minimal Cargo dependency-name wiring repair for the actual new-head serde_yaml regression; no Rust source, Cargo manifest, lockfile, feature or gate changes.
actual_failure: E0433 serde_yaml unresolved in skills parser.rs at lines36,50,57,168. GNU release also fails the skills unit-test binary; SDK fails the shared skills library.
cause: The workspace Cargo alias maps serde_yaml to serde_norway0.9.42. The pinned rules_rs0.0.96 generates aliases(), but codex_rust_crate previously passed only deps and never passed these aliases to rules_rust.

api_sources.fact: Cargo rename is mapped from the resolved bazel_target; normal/dev/build and platform dependency sets are separately recorded.
aliases is a label_keyed_string_dict; the unit-test crate inherits and extends the library aliases.

design: Filter generated aliases to the same dependency kind and platform branch as each rule; retain shared aliases in every branch. Rewrite selected alias keys through the same Label-normalized test dependency replacements. Reject conflicting replacement aliases. This avoids introducing dev-only or foreign-platform graph edges merely by setting aliases. External @crates replacements are ignored exactly as rust_test_dependencies ignores them; aliases do not redirect an edge which the dependency helper retained.
complete_consumer_evidence: All direct serde_norway dependencies were enumerated from exact 1e91 Cargo.lock, then each corresponding exact Cargo.toml and BUILD invocation was checked.

target_emission.coverage: Actual macro and helpers executed with synthetic external dependency/platform fixtures; all non-alias attributes unchanged; alias keys subset selected deps; all nine Rust rule callsites wired. This is not Bazel analysis or Rust compilation.
